dpv.note: DPV is a W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group report (not a normative W3C Recommendation). Used here strictly as a descriptive taxonomy for observed browser surface categories.

iso27560.note: Provides structural alignment for receipt provenance, notice references, and evidence states without claiming legal consent validity.

gpc.note: GPC (Sec-GPC: 1 / navigator.globalPrivacyControl) is a technical user preference signal. It is not legally binding by itself; legal obligations depend on applicable jurisdiction (such as CCPA regulations), and remote server compliance cannot be verified by this browser extension.
